metadata.title: Device Attestation

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for producing verifiable evidence of device integrity and execution state to support trust evaluation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Embedded platforms, firmware stacks, secure boot chains, hardware roots of trust, and device integrity measurement mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining device attestation as integrity evidence, not trust, authorization, or safety assurance.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines attestation outputs as integrity evidence data used to inform downstream trust decisions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Establishes expectations for firmware integrity, secure boot, and platform trust anchors.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines baseline expectations for device software integrity and configuration state.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that integrity evidence must be continuously evaluated and is not equivalent to trust.

metadata.remarks: Device Attestation defines how devices produce verifiable evidence of platform and execution integrity. This pattern does not assert device correctness, safety, authorization, mission suitability, or regulatory compliance.

components.title: Device Integrity Measurement
components.description: Measurement of firmware, configuration, and execution state for integrity assessment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Platform components are measured and protected against unauthorized modification.

components.title: Device Attestation Evidence
components.description: Production of cryptographically verifiable integrity evidence consumable by relying systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device software integrity and configuration state are attestable.

components.title: Attestation Freshness
components.description: Ensures attestation evidence reflects current or recent device state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Attestation evidence is time‑bound and contextually valid.

components.title: Device Attestation Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what successful device attestation does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Attestation does not imply authorization, safety, correctness, or mission approval.
